title: AIMS.AU: A DATASET FOR THE ANALYSIS OF MODERN SLAVERY COUNTERMEASURES IN CORPORATE STATEMENTS
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset and evaluates Large Language Models on their ability to extract information related to corporate compliance with modern slavery laws. While the content involves human rights and corporate ethics, the benchmarking focuses on technical information extraction (e.g., identifying descriptions of supply chains or remediation actions) rather than evaluating the models' own ethical reasoning, moral judgment, or religious values.
